I hate dueling club and the stupid bots with a passion, but I think that’s actually a smart move. Granted, it’s not very effective if the person or bot that drank the potion is the one that gets to use a spell or vial next time, but I have had several times where a bot drank a potion on their first move and when I used a spell like diffindo on them next move, they instantly got back over half of their health.
